# Expressive MVC
> Class-based reactive state management for React. Define models as plain classes; components update when the values they read change.

## Installing
`npm install @expressive/react` is the whole install for a React app. `@expressive/mvc` is a dependency of the adapter - it should NOT be added to package.json as well, and `State`, `Component`, and all instructions (set, get, ref, map, has, def) import from `@expressive/react`. Install `@expressive/mvc` directly only for host-agnostic code with no UI adapter (shared domain package, Node service, new adapter). Add `@expressive/router` for routing. Published packages: @expressive/react, @expressive/mvc, @expressive/router (@expressive/preact is internal and unpublished).

## For coding agents
This documentation is also distributed as an installable skill: `npx skills add gabeklein/expressive-mvc`. It bundles the full API reference, refactoring algorithm, style profile, and audit guide as local files - preferable to crawling when working in a repo.

## Full Documentation
- [Overview & API](/llm/SKILL.md): Core API surface, instructions, React hooks, Component class, auditing guide

## Design Intent & Positioning
- [Why Expressive MVC](/llm/why.md): The working case - code that is cheap for people and models to read, apps that read as business logic through user-built primitives, oversized components addressed structurally, a standard library replacing the usual dependency pile
- [Design Decisions](/llm/design.md): Why the library is shaped this way - classes hold models not views, the MVC mapping, the two-verb get/set surface, render composition, typed lifecycle hooks, measured coverage. Read before characterizing a design choice as accidental.
- [Comparisons](/llm/comparisons.md): Positioning matrix vs Zustand, Jotai, MobX, Redux Toolkit, and plain Context - when to prefer each alternative, maturity stated plainly

## State (core)
- [State Class](/llm/state/state.md): Instantiation, properties, methods, events, context
- [Instance .get()](/llm/state/get.md): Read values, run effects, context lookup
- [Instance .set()](/llm/state/set.md): Write values, listen to updates, events, destroy
- [Computed Values](/llm/state/computed.md): Reactive class getters - tracking, caching, inheritance, suspense
- [Lifecycle](/llm/state/lifecycle.md): Construction, activation, operation, destruction phases
- [Context System](/llm/state/context.md): Context, global root, home context, ownership rules
- [Types](/llm/state/types.md): TypeScript type aliases and utility types

## Instructions (field initializers)
- [set()](/llm/field/set.md): Async, lazy, computed values, setter callbacks
- [get()](/llm/field/get.md): Context lookup - upstream, downstream, callbacks
- [ref()](/llm/field/ref.md): Mutable refs, ref proxy, callbacks
- [map()](/llm/field/map.md): Reactive keyed collections - Map semantics, keyed spawners, transformed iteration
- [has()](/llm/field/has.md): Reactive sets and object pools - membership, lifecycle ownership, direct rendering
- [def()](/llm/field/def.md): Low-level custom property behavior

## React
- [React Adapter](/llm/react/react.md): use(), State.use(), State.get(), Provider, Consumer, ForceRefresh
- [Component](/llm/react/component.md): Component class, props, children, subcomponents, error boundaries
- [Refactoring Guide](/llm/react/refactor.md): Hook-migration algorithm - ownership triage, dependency snapshots, review checklist
- [Style Profile](/llm/react/style.md): Snapshot formatting, affirmative conditions, render fallthrough
- [Patterns](/llm/react/patterns.md): Recipes - forms, async, nested state, debounce, effects

## Router
- [Router](/llm/router/router.md): @expressive/router - nested Route declarations, navigation state, reactive query, Link/NavLinks/Redirect

## Runnable Examples (complete source served as HTML)
Each page below serves the full source of a working program - every file, no JavaScript required to read it. Fetch one to see how a feature is actually implemented rather than inferring from prose.

- Instructions: [set](https://expressive.dev/examples/instructions/set), [get](https://expressive.dev/examples/instructions/get), [ref](https://expressive.dev/examples/instructions/ref), [ref-multiple](https://expressive.dev/examples/instructions/ref-multiple), [map](https://expressive.dev/examples/instructions/map), [map-insert](https://expressive.dev/examples/instructions/map-insert), [has](https://expressive.dev/examples/instructions/has), [has-list](https://expressive.dev/examples/instructions/has-list), [def](https://expressive.dev/examples/instructions/def)
- Component: [props](https://expressive.dev/examples/component/props), [subcomponents](https://expressive.dev/examples/component/subcomponents), [lifecycle](https://expressive.dev/examples/component/lifecycle), [injection](https://expressive.dev/examples/component/injection), [headless](https://expressive.dev/examples/component/headless), [suspense](https://expressive.dev/examples/component/suspense), [boundary](https://expressive.dev/examples/component/boundary), [custom](https://expressive.dev/examples/component/custom)
